script_text: Tonight, water sign Pisces, destiny pulls your future into focus. Wednesday is tense: Mercury in your 7th House squares Uranus in your 4th House, disrupting conversations. Wednesday is tense: Mars, your 2nd House ruler, squares Jupiter in your 6th House, causing career overload and financial risk. Mars sextiles Saturn in your 1st House, pressure becomes progress. By midweek, the Sun squares Uranus in your 4th House, ending a domestic loop. Venus in your 7th House favors honest love talks; Neptune, your ruling planet in your 1st House, clouds confidence. Friday's Mercury conjuncts the Sun in your 7th House, clarifying decisions. The weekend favors romance and shared finance reviews; Sunday is practical. Friday is your power day: Mercury conjuncts the Sun, clarifying decisions. Wednesday is hardest: Mercury squares Uranus, amplifying confusion. Write down a financial question, verify numbers, act after intuition settles. Follow for daily updates.
